from tinydb import TinyDB, where

# Test edge cases
db = TinyDB(':memory:')

# Test empty string prefix
db.insert_multiple([{'name': ''}, {'name': 'A'}, {'name': 'Al'}])
print('empty prefix:', [d['name'] for d in db.search(where('name').startswith(''))])

# Test missing field
db2 = TinyDB(':memory:')

print('missing field:', [d.get('name') for d in db2.search(where('name').startswith('Al'))])

# Test empty string suffix
db3 = TinyDB(':memory:')
db3.insert_multiple([{'name': ''}, {'name': 'A'}, {'name': 'Al'}])
print('empty suffix:', [d['name'] for d in db3.search(where('name').endswith(''))])

# Test combining with other queries
db4 = TinyDB(':memory:')
db4.insert_multiple([{'name': 'Alice', 'age': 30}, {'name': 'Alan', 'age': 25}, {'name': 'Bob', 'age': 30}])
print('combined:', [d['name'] for d in db4.search((where('name').startswith('Al')) & (where('age') > 25))])
""}
